goal: Across the independently executable quote services, introduce free shipping for orders whose checked subtotal is at least 10000 cents. Empty and zero-valued orders remain free; positive orders below the threshold retain the existing 500-cent fee. Preserve public APIs, exact checked arithmetic, invalid-input behavior, local money helpers, all existing tests, and unrelated user changes. Do not claim Rust runtime validation without a compiler.

targets.javascript_typescript: apps/storefront/src/quote.js :: quote(lines), local TS dependency packages/money/src/amount.ts :: checkedSubtotal(lines)
